name: godcontrol
description: Securely inspect and operate explicitly enrolled computers through bounded MCP tools.

interface.longDescription: Connect ChatGPT or Codex to computers you explicitly enroll. Inspect files, Git state, system information, and approved processes through an OAuth-protected MCP hub while local devices connect outbound and keep their local MCP ports private.
interface.defaultPrompt: List my connected GodControl devices and show which are online.
